stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.meaningZh: 西方人；西部片；西部小说
items.sentenceEn: They watch a western set on the old frontier.
items.sentenceZh: 他们观看一部以旧时边疆为背景的西部片。
items.scene: A stylized classic western film scene shows two adult riders in broad-brimmed hats guiding horses past a wooden frontier town, red-rock canyon and stagecoach at sunset. The image evokes the western genre without firearms, violence, flags or real historical figures.
items.altText: 两名骑手经过木结构边疆小镇，远处有红岩峡谷和驿马车。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher relates the flower to the visiting bee.
items.sentenceZh: 老师把花朵与来访的蜜蜂联系起来。
items.scene: An adult ecology teacher places a model flower and a model bee side by side, connecting them with one curved strand of colored cord. Two adult learners observe how the matching pollen shapes on bee and flower relate to each other.
items.altText: 生态老师用一根彩线连接花朵和蜜蜂模型，展示两者的联系。

items.sentenceEn: They travel across the mountains by train.
items.sentenceZh: 他们乘火车穿越群山旅行。
items.scene: A passenger train curves through a broad mountain valley while two adult travelers look through a large carriage window with small luggage beside them. The winding track and changing landscape emphasize movement over a long distance.
items.altText: 旅客从车窗观看列车沿弯曲铁轨穿越广阔山谷。

items.sentenceEn: The neighbors debate two plans for the empty lot.
items.sentenceZh: 邻居们就空地的两种规划方案展开辩论。
items.scene: Exactly two adult speakers stand at separate plain lecterns in a community hall, each gesturing toward one different model for an empty lot. A seated adult moderator listens between them while a small audience watches respectfully. No campaign imagery or text.
items.altText: 两名发言者在社区会堂分别阐述空地规划方案，主持人居中倾听。

items.sentenceEn: The barriers prevent rainwater from entering the shop.
items.sentenceZh: 这些挡水设施防止雨水进入商店。
items.scene: During heavy rain, two adults secure a continuous line of water-filled flood barriers across a shop entrance. Shallow runoff visibly diverts around the barrier while the dry floor and goods remain protected inside.
items.altText: 暴雨中，连续挡水设施把积水引向两侧，商店内部保持干燥。

items.sentenceEn: A citizen speaks at the public town meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 一位市民在公开的城镇会议上发言。
items.scene: One adult resident speaks calmly at an open town meeting, facing a semicircle of fellow residents and local civic staff. A scale model of their shared public square sits in the center, establishing participation as a citizen in community affairs without flags, parties or official seals.
items.altText: 一位市民在公开会议上面对居民发言，中央摆着公共广场模型。

items.sentenceEn: The majority chooses the garden design.
items.sentenceZh: 大多数人选择了花园方案。
items.scene: Exactly eight adults make a visible choice between two tabletop models. Exactly six stand behind the garden model and exactly two stand behind the paved-plaza model, making the larger majority unmistakable. No ballots, parties, text or national symbols.
items.altText: 八人分成两组，其中六人选择花园模型，两人选择铺装广场模型。

items.sentenceEn: None of the five hooks holds a coat.
items.sentenceZh: 五个挂钩上一个外套也没有。
items.scene: Exactly five large wall hooks are shown in one clear row, and every hook is completely empty. Five coats remain neatly folded in a basket below, reinforcing that none is hanging.
items.altText: 一排恰好五个挂钩全部空着，五件外套叠放在下方篮子里。

items.sentenceEn: She waits at the front of the line.
items.sentenceZh: 她排在队伍的最前面。
items.scene: A clearly ordered line of five adults waits at a bakery counter. One woman stands at the very front beside the counter and is being served, while four people queue directly behind her along a floor guide with no writing.
items.altText: 五人排队等候，最前面的女子站在柜台旁接受服务。

items.sentenceEn: The baby was born early this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 这个宝宝今天清晨出生了。
items.scene: In a calm maternity room at sunrise, a swaddled newborn rests safely in one parent's arms while the other parent sits close and smiles. A healthcare professional checks the baby's blanket from a respectful distance, with no clinical procedure or exposed body.
items.altText: 清晨的产科房间里，父母安静地抱着裹好的新生儿。

items.meaningZh: 承认；接受；允许进入；容许
items.sentenceEn: The usher admits the guest into the concert hall.
items.sentenceZh: 引座员允许这位客人进入音乐厅。
items.scene: At a concert-hall entrance, an adult usher checks a plain ticket with no writing, opens the velvet-rope gate and warmly gestures for one adult guest to enter. Other visitors wait outside while the admitted guest crosses the threshold.
items.altText: 引座员检查无字票券后打开隔离绳，让一名客人进入音乐厅。

items.meaningZh: 年长者；资深者；毕业班学生
items.sentenceEn: The senior engineer guides the new team.
items.sentenceZh: 资深工程师指导新团队。
items.scene: An experienced adult engineer leads three newer adult colleagues around a large bridge model, pointing out a structural joint while the others take measurements and listen. Her confident guidance and the team's attention establish senior professional status.
items.altText: 资深工程师在桥梁模型旁指出结构节点，三名新同事认真测量和倾听。

items.sentenceEn: They assume the two samples are the same before testing them.
items.sentenceZh: 检测之前，他们假设两个样本相同。
items.scene: Two adult laboratory researchers compare two identical-looking clear liquid samples before testing. One gestures that they appear equal while the other prepares a color-changing test strip; a third already-tested sample shows that appearances can be misleading. No labels or readable notes.
items.altText: 研究人员面对两个外观相同的液体样本，在检验前暂时认为它们相同。

items.sentenceEn: Strong wind bends the grass near the coast.
items.sentenceZh: 强风吹弯了海岸附近的草。
items.scene: A strong coastal wind sweeps across a headland, bending tall grass and a small tree in one shared direction. An adult walker leans forward while holding a hat securely, and seabirds glide on the visible air current.
items.altText: 海岸强风把草和小树吹向同一方向，行人前倾并按住帽子。

items.sentenceEn: The brass key opens the garden gate.
items.sentenceZh: 这把黄铜钥匙打开了花园门。
items.scene: A close illustrated view shows an adult gardener turning one distinctive brass key in the lock of an old iron garden gate. The gate has just begun to open onto a lush garden, making the key and its function unmistakable.
items.altText: 园丁把一把黄铜钥匙插入铁门锁孔，花园门正开始打开。

items.meaningZh: 专业人才；专业的；职业的
items.sentenceEn: A professional pastry chef finishes the dessert.
items.sentenceZh: 一位专业糕点师完成了这道甜点。
items.scene: In an orderly bakery kitchen, an adult professional pastry chef in clean practical uniform uses precise tools to finish a refined dessert while two trainees observe. Organized ingredients, controlled technique and confident posture communicate professional expertise without branding.
items.altText: 专业糕点师在整洁厨房中用精细工具完成甜点，两名学员在旁观察。

items.meaningZh: 任务；代表团；使命；传教团
items.sentenceEn: Their mission is to repair the satellite.
items.sentenceZh: 他们的任务是修复卫星。
items.scene: Two fictional astronauts work together outside an unbranded spacecraft to repair one damaged communications satellite above Earth. One stabilizes a panel while the other installs a replacement component, making their shared mission specific and purposeful.
items.altText: 两名宇航员在地球上空协作修复一颗受损卫星。

items.sentenceEn: The cyclist moves fast around the track.
items.sentenceZh: 骑车手沿赛道快速前进。
items.scene: A helmeted adult track cyclist speeds around a banked velodrome curve with controlled posture. Strong directional streaks, spinning wheels and trailing competitors far behind communicate fast motion while preserving realistic safety gear.
items.altText: 戴头盔的自行车手高速驶过倾斜赛道弯道，车轮和背景呈现明显动感。

items.meaningZh: 孤独的；单独的；独自的；独自地
items.sentenceEn: She camps alone beside the quiet lake.
items.sentenceZh: 她独自在安静的湖边露营。
items.scene: Exactly one adult camper sits beside one small tent at a quiet lakeshore, preparing a warm drink and watching the evening reflection. No other people, vehicles, dwellings or human silhouettes appear anywhere in the landscape.
items.altText: 安静湖边只有一名露营者和一顶帐篷，她独自准备热饮。

items.sentenceEn: The customer chooses a loaf at the bakery.
items.sentenceZh: 顾客在面包店挑选一条面包。
items.scene: At a neighborhood bakery counter, one adult customer points to a particular loaf in the display while an adult baker lifts it with tongs and prepares a plain paper bag. Their positions on opposite sides of the counter clearly distinguish customer from seller.
items.altText: 顾客在柜台外指向一条面包，柜台内的面包师用夹子取出。
